title: Heathrow Terminal 5: opening a service is an integration test
focus: Operational readiness depends on people, logistics, software, facilities, and shared authority working together under representative conditions.

sources.title: House of Commons Transport Committee: The opening of Heathrow Terminal 5
sources.limitations: Committee conclusions and witness accounts are distinguishable; trial participation alone does not establish trial representativeness.

sources.title: The opening of Heathrow Terminal 5: communication and lessons
sources.limitations: The committee explicitly avoided certainty that better cooperation would have prevented every problem.

facts.statement: The committee found that building delays compressed staff familiarisation and questioned whether training and trials prepared staff for opening conditions.
It examined communication failures between operator and airline and the treatment of concerns raised by staff.

retrospective.boundary: Passenger journey, staff access, baggage flow, facilities, airline processes, terminal operator, and disruption recovery form the service boundary.
interfaces: Facilities handover → staff training: incomplete spaces can invalidate planned familiarisation.
Airline → terminal operator: baggage and passenger exceptions require shared ownership and rapid coordination.

decision.question: What evidence supports opening when subsystem completion reports are favorable?
options: Exercise end-to-end journeys and exceptions with representative staff, loads, and facilities.
decision.recommendation: Use an integrated readiness decision with explicit exception handling and a staged transition option.
decision.uncertainty: The historical report does not prove which exact staging plan would have prevented the disruption.

rows: Demonstrate access, orientation, and workstation readiness
Follow a delayed or misrouted bag across organizational boundaries
Timed exception recovery and accountable owner
Agree service reduction and recovery authority

questions: How can all component owners report green while the service remains unready?
What does attendance prove about training, and what does it not prove?
Write a readiness recommendation that makes a phased opening decision reviewable.
answer_signals: Models handovers and exceptions, not only nominal flow.
Distinguishes activity completion from demonstrated performance.
Includes front-line knowledge and joint operational authority.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: a hospital moves into a new building while its scheduling software also changes. Select three cross-team acceptance scenarios.
retrospective.limits: The proposed readiness slice is new teaching material, not a recovered airport acceptance plan.
